title: Costa Rica letter of 180 signers on solidarity taxes, July 2020
notes: Primary PDF retrieved from Observador.cr (180 signature lines, 179 unique names; Rose Mary Rodríguez Bustos listed twice). Letter explicitly proposes a temporary broad-based tax on financial wealth ("tributo también temporal, mínimo, pero de amplia base, a la riqueza financiera"), Grade B. Recorded: 8 existing actors (A0018, A0019, A0022, A0023, A0025, A0026, A0036, A0041) + 27 new living public figures (A0043-A0069); 2 deceased signers added to exclusions (X0013 Dionisio Cabal Antillón, X0014 Álvaro Marenco Marrocchi); remaining 142 private citizens/unverified individuals omitted.
